newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel seizes heroin haul, army officer arrested.
newsitem.headline: Israel seizes heroin haul, army officer arrested.

text.p: The Israeli army said on Friday an officer in a border tracking unit had been arrested on suspicion of playing a key role in smuggling a haul of $2 million worth of heroin from Jordan.

"Late on November 7 detectives in the field, acting on intelligence that drugs were to be smuggled over the border from Jordan, saw the major transfer a plastic barrel to a known drug dealer," an army spokeswoman said.

"Afterward, the dealer and two others were arrested and detectives seized the barrel, which held more than 14 kg (30.8 pounds) of heroin, worth about $2 million. The major was then arrested at his base."

Police said the major held an administrative position in a unit of trackers deployed along Israel's desert borders with Jordan and Egypt to detect and prevent the passage of arms, guerrillas and drugs into the Jewish state.
They said the drug haul in the remote Arava desert was the largest seized in southern Israel.
